page: Microsoft Azure L32aos_v5 is a member of the Laosv5 server family, utilizing dedicated AMD processors on the x86_64 architecture. This virtual machine is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

A primary feature of the L32aos_v5 is its substantial local storage capacity, which consists of 23,038 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Additionally, the instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing for integration with high-performance external storage options. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses or integrated graphics processing units.

Given the high density of local NVMe SSD storage and the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server type offers a specialized hardware profile for data-intensive operations. The massive local storage capacity makes it highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring large-scale, low-latency local scratch space or high-throughput database operations. Appropriate workloads include large relational databases, NoSQL databases, data warehousing, and big data analytics that benefit from high-capacity local NVMe storage and substantial memory overhead.
